# hallpass_server (Resource)

A destination server agents reach through the gateway. Pin its host key with `hallpass_host_key` and add roles with `hallpass_role`. Destroying it deletes the server and all of its roles: access ends, login keys are revoked, and the record stays only so history can name it. Import with the server ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_server" "web1" {
  alias       = "web1"
  description = "Public web front end (nginx)"
  environment = "production"
  address     = "10.0.1.11"
  groups      = ["prod-web"]
  labels      = { env = "prod", tier = "web" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Host name or IP address the gateway connects to. It must be inside the gateway's `egress.allow_cidrs`.
- `alias` (String) Unique name agents use. Gateway command words are reserved.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `display_name` (String) Display name (defaults to the alias).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `environment` (String) Environment, e.g. `production` (informational).
- `groups` (Set of String) Groups of the server, used by policy selectors.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the server, used by policy selectors.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form metadata (informational).
- `port` (Number) SSH port.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server ID (`srv_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Server ID
terraform import hallpass_server.web1 srv_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
